snippet.title: Goblin Solitaire
snippet.description:
A cozy fantasy take on classic Klondike solitaire.

Customize cards and backgrounds, unlock achievements, track your progress, and relax in a charming goblin-inspired world with original music and multiple difficulty settings.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4854700/Goblin_Solitaire/

Release Date: July 10, 2026
